blends.name: Membership Fighter Blend
blends.desc:
This blend requires 3 of the 4ArtSake Scarab Tokens. 3 token = 1 of the 14 fighters.
out of tokens, some can be found on the 2ndary market here
https://neftyblocks.com/marketplace/listing?template_id=296045&collection_name=bmac4artsake&sort=price&order=asc&page=1

blends.desc:

Missing a fighter? There are some available on the 2ndary market here
https://neftyblocks.com/marketplace/listing?collection_name=bigbanggames&page=1&schema_name=rumble.club&sort=price&order=asc
